comparison.objective: Identify by touch and remove the unloaded prop while leaving the slab unchanged; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Tactile load discrimination and support removal versus tool alignment, counterholding, collar rotation and relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Only the non-load-bearing prop is removed and slab preserved versus valid repeated stops and lock retention.
comparison.reason: The task tests force sensing and structural support selection, not dynamic damper commissioning. Detailed load and slab-motion thresholds are absent.
